observations: Two black PlayStation 4 consoles are shown, stacked vertically.
The console on the right has a visible PlayStation logo on the front panel.
The console on the left has a textured, possibly scratched or worn, surface.
Both consoles appear to be in a retail environment with shelves of electronics in the background.
The consoles are placed on a white plastic bag with 'McSteve' branding.
No controllers, power cables, or other accessories are visible in the photos.
The seller claims it is a 'Sony PS4 Pro Console' with one controller and UK receipt, but no controller or receipt is shown.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.
No controller is visible in either photo. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed from the images.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the console's front or side showing the model label or disc drive type.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standard PS4, not PS4 Pro, which affects value.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and displaying the PS4 home screen.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which significantly reduces value.

risks.risk: Controller is not included or is damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the controller showing its condition and a video of it connecting to the console.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as no controller included, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Receipt is not genuine or is missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the receipt showing the date, store, and item details.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as no receipt, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Photo of the console's front or side showing the model label or disc drive type.
Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Photo of the controller showing its condition and a video of it connecting to the console.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
